verdict.rationale: Composio ships an official hosted MCP server. Composio Connect at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp works with any MCP-compatible client. SDK sessions can also expose a hosted MCP server via `mcp: true`, and `composio.mcp.create` builds per-toolkit MCP servers, all documented first-party and confirmed by a probe. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Composio Connect is an MCP server at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp that gives your AI agent access to 1000+ apps
Use Composio Connect when you already have an MCP-compatible client and want the shared Composio MCP URL, without creating an SDK session.
Opt into MCP by passing `mcp: true` when you create the session. The session then exposes its hosted MCP server.
